data.one_liner: Widget that arranges children in a circle and lets them rotate via scrolling
data.what_it_does: CircularMotion places a list of widgets around a central widget in a circular layout. The items can be scrolled to rotate around the center, optionally continuing to spin after the gesture ends.
use_when: You need a circular arrangement of widgets that can be interacted with via scrolling
You want a simple, declarative way to create a rotating circular menu or gallery
You need a customizable center widget and optional post-gesture spin
avoid_when: You require complex physics-based motion beyond simple rotation
You need high-performance handling of a very large number of children
You need integration with other animation libraries that require custom controllers
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single line of code
Supports both list and builder constructors
Provides optional post-gesture spin and gesture behavior customization
weaknesses: No advanced physics or animation customization beyond basic rotation
Documentation is minimal and may lack performance guidance
data.minimal_example:
CircularMotion(
  centerWidget: Text('Center'),
  children: [
    Text('0'),
    Text('1'),
    Text('2'),
    Text('3'),
  ],
)
